title: Glottolog 5.4 counted 7,685 spoken first languages on 10 November 2026
summary: On 10 November 2026, Glottolog 5.4 listed 7,685 spoken L1 languages, and called the classification its best guess.
body: The Glottolog 5.4 information page says that currently, on 10 November 2026, there are 7,685 spoken L1 languages, meaning spoken languages traditionally used by a community as their first language. The editors say the classification is their best guess, and that for many groups there is little historical-comparative research, so classifications can change. Distinct, on that page, means not mutually intelligible with any other language. The page also says Glottolog is complete only for classifiable languages. A round number without the version and the date would hide those limits. Another catalogue can draw the language-versus-dialect line differently.

sources.title: Glottolog 5.4, About Languoids
sources.author: Glottolog editors
sources.note: Opened 2026-11-26. The page dates its counts 'Currently 2026-11-10'. Supports the 7,685 spoken L1 count dated 2026-11-10, the best-guess caveat, the mutual-intelligibility criterion, and the statement that Glottolog is complete only for classifiable languages.
